name: Mi Chico Dance: Do the Trend From Your Photo
blurb: The Mi Chico dance is the TikTok trend to DJ Goja's 2026 hit "Mi Chico", remixed with Jason Derulo in June: hand rolls over the chest, arm rolls, hands up by the head and hip sways.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: kling-3-motion, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Character replacement on the video, moment for moment. Replace the character in the video with the person from the uploaded image. Keep the camera movement and the timing of the video, as one continuous handheld shot. No text or logos. Photorealistic, identity consistent for the whole clip.
Keep actions, poses, facial expressions and rhythm. Preserve the person's original facial features, maintain character consistency, no distortion, no glitches, no artifacts. The person dances in the place from the uploaded image, in the clothes and shoes from the uploaded image, not the beige tube top or the grey-green wide sweatpants of the dancer in the video, and keeps their own hair from the uploaded image, not long dark hair. Follow the dancer's moves and timing exactly: both hands up at the sides of the head, the hands framing the face, the arm swing and the hair flip, the steps toward the camera with hip sways, the wide side lunge, the arm rolls and the hand rolls in front of the chest, the chest brushes, the knee lift with a hand by the face, both hands up on top of the head with the elbows wide, and the arms thrown out at the end. Natural balance and stable ground contact. Exactly one person, no other people. One continuous shot, no cuts, no text, no captions, no logos.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Character replacement on [Video 1], moment for moment. The woman on the left is now the person in [Image 1], and the man on the right is now the person in [Image 2].
Keep the dance studio with the dark grey wall, the red ceiling, the small white wall unit, the pink side light and the grey floor, the camera movement and the timing of [Video 1], as one continuous shot. No text or logos. Photorealistic, identity consistent for the whole clip. Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same fixed camera, framing, timing and dance moves, both dancers in full view from head to feet.

Dancer 1 (left) = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. They wear the clothes and shoes from [Image 1]. NO grey cross-print T-shirt, no camo cargo pants and no red hair ends unless [Image 1] shows them.

Dancer 2 (right) = the person in [Image 2], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 2] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. They wear the clothes and shoes from [Image 2]. NO cap, no black T-shirt and no olive cargo pants unless [Image 2] shows them.

The same real people in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also during the hair flips and the turns. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancers' faces, never add or remove facial hair. Do not mix the two faces: [Image 1] is only dancer 1 on the left, [Image 2] is only dancer 2 on the right. Both change: no one from the video stays.

The dance, matching the reference second by second, on the beat, both dancers in sync:
0-4.5 s: they stand side by side and sway to the intro, one hand on the chest, the other hand brushing the hair and the face.
4.5-6.5 s: wide lunges to the side with big arm sweeps.
6.5-9 s: arm rolls and hand waves in front of the body, quick steps.
9-11 s: hand flicks by the face, chest brushes, a hair flip.
11-13 s: hand rolls at the chest, small steps and hip sways.
13-15 s: both hands up behind the head, elbows wide, a sway to the end pose.

Anatomy rules: one head per person, on that person's own shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. Exactly two people. Natural balance, stable ground contact. No extra dancers, duplicate bodies, extra limbs, fused fingers, text, logos or watermark.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Animate the three people in [Image 1], [Image 2] and [Image 3] into a 15-second crew dance video on the rooftop parking lot at sunset, as one continuous handheld shot. No text or logos. Photorealistic, identity consistent for the whole clip. Vertical 9:16, like a real phone video.

Map the three friends from viewer-left to viewer-right and keep those identity assignments fixed in every shot. The friend in the MIDDLE, who takes the selfie, is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). The friend on the LEFT is the person in [Image 2]: copy the exact face from [Image 2]. The friend on the RIGHT is the person in [Image 3]: copy the exact face from [Image 3]. All three are adults. Never blend their faces, never transfer a face; each keeps their own face, hair and build from the first frame to the last, also in the huddle and the selfie, so their friends recognize them at once. Each wears the clothes from their own photo; what a photo does not show is casual streetwear with baggy trousers and sneakers. If an image shows an animal, that friend is that animal, upright, with its own face and fur.

The place: the rooftop parking lot at sunset: the empty top deck of a parking garage, grey concrete with faded white lines, a low wall at the edge, tall street lamps that start to glow, low buildings far away, a clear sky from blue to warm orange. No cars, no signs, no other people.

The shots, one take on the beat:
0-2.5 s: the phone lies on the ground, looking up at the sky: the three friends lean in over it in a tight circle, looking down into the lens with big grins, pointing at it and flashing peace signs.
2.5-5 s: the person in [Image 1] grabs the phone for a selfie at arm's length: a close, smiling selfie, the other two just behind; then a hand sweeps across the lens in a quick blur.
5-15 s: a wide shot at chest height that drifts in a slow arc: all three in a row, head to sneakers, [Image 1] in the middle a half step in front, dance in sync:
5-7 s: a point at the camera, then both hands roll over the stomach and up the chest.
7-9 s: chest brushes and arm rolls, small steps from side to side with hip sways.
9-11 s: a clap above the head, then quick punches toward the camera.
11-13 s: both hands up beside the head, framing the face, a quick hair flip.
13-15 s: both hands behind the head, elbows wide, a sway into the end pose with big smiles, all three faces large and sharp.

Audio: an original upbeat Afro house beat with shakers and hand claps, soft laughter in the huddle; no known song, no lyrics, no singing, no talking.

Exactly three people: no fourth person, never merge bodies. NO ROLE SWAP. No famous people, no children. No sunglasses or hats unless a photo shows them. Five fingers per hand. No foot sliding, no outfit flicker. No captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 14 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Character replacement on [Video 1], moment for moment. The pink bunny in the rhinestone sunglasses is now the pet in [Image 1].
Keep the plain white studio, the camera movement and the timing of [Video 1], as one continuous shot. No text or logos. Photorealistic, identity consistent for the whole clip. Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same white background and soft shadow, the same fixed camera with the same short push-in, the same framing, timing and dance moves.

The dancer = the pet in [Image 1], in every frame: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length, markings and body shape as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it from the first second to the last. Real fur, a real animal, not a cartoon. It stands upright on its hind legs like a person the whole time. Never drift back to the bunny of the original video: no pink fur, no long floppy bunny ears and no white belly patch unless [Image 1] shows them. The pet wears the same rhinestone sunglasses and the same thin gold chain with a small gold pendant, and nothing else: its own fur from head to toe. If [Image 1] shows a dog, a cat or another animal, that animal dances in the same place with the same moves, with its own ears and muzzle.

The pet reproduces the bunny's full dance frame by frame with the same timing, with a happy, cheeky face. Matching the reference second by second:
0-1 s: it stands facing the camera and points one front paw at the lens, then rolls both paws over its belly.
1-2 s: a step to the side, one paw on the chest.
2-3 s: a quick turn sideways with a hop, the paws swinging.
3-5.5 s: back to the camera, little side steps, the paws rolling in front of the chest and a clap by the face.
5.5-7 s: it leans in toward the camera with one paw up by the face, then steps back.
7-9 s: a quick turn to the side, then both paws brushing the chest and crossed.
9-12 s: both front paws up beside the head, then behind the head, with a sway.
12-14 s: little fists at the belly with a bounce, then one paw out toward the camera.

The pet keeps real animal anatomy: furry front legs ending in round paws covered in its own fur, never human hands, no bare skin, no fingers. One head only, two hind legs and two front legs, no extra legs or paws. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no people, no extra animals.

Maintain exactly FIVE animals in every scene. Do not add, remove, merge or duplicate characters. If two images show the same animal, it dances in both places, as look-alike twins.

Each pet is the animal in its own image, in every frame, the same species and breed. Preserve its real facial markings, ears, muzzle, eyes, fur colors and body proportions, with the natural body volume of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged, so its owner knows it at once. Never blend two pets or move markings from one to another. Each must remain a real-looking animal, not a human, an animated mascot or a cartoon, no clothes. It may perform a playful stylized upright dance while retaining recognizable animal anatomy: furry front legs with round paws, never human hands.

The place: the rooftop parking lot at sunset: the empty top deck of a parking garage, grey concrete with faded white lines, a low wall at the edge, tall street lamps that start to glow, low buildings far away, a clear sky from blue to warm orange. No cars, no signs, no other people.

One continuous take, timed on the beat:
[0-2.5s]: the phone lies on the ground, looking up at the sky: the five pets lean in over it in a tight circle, looking down into the lens.
[2.5-5s]: the pet from [Image 1] grabs the phone in its front paws for a close selfie, the other four just behind it; then a paw sweeps across the lens.
[5-15s]: a low wide shot drifting in a slow arc: all five in a row, upright on their hind legs, head to toes, [Image 1] a half step in front, dance in sync:
5-7 s: a paw points at the camera, then both paws roll over the belly and up the chest.
7-9 s: chest brushes and paw rolls, small side hops with hip sways.
9-11 s: a clap above the head, then quick paw punches toward the camera.
11-13 s: both paws up beside the head, framing the face.
13-15 s: both paws behind the head, a sway into the end pose, all five faces large and sharp.

No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music: a song is put on afterwards.

STRICTLY AVOID: identity changes, face swapping between characters, missing characters, extra people, extra animals, duplicate limbs, distorted faces, humanized animals, captions, logos, watermarks.
